notes: Existing STS API handles external/federated principals with external_id enforcement; no duplicate SSO issuance path was introduced.
Scope is intentionally limited to deterministic API runtime proof and plan/evidence status.

known_gaps.reason: Provider-managed IdP CRUD/runtime adapter remains separate from this STS issuance proof.
No live cloud or self-hosted IdP endpoint was contacted.

findings: The success test constructs an OIDC provider, external principal, trust role, and STS API request, then asserts session id, assumed_by, external_id, expiry, scope, and token fingerprint.
The denial test asserts missing external_id maps to CloudIamError::ExternalIdRequired and HTTP 403 status.
The targeted tests are deterministic, in-memory, and run inside the existing oya-cloud-iam-api integration suite.
The tests reuse existing domain and API surfaces; no new crate, dependency, provider adapter, or cross-layer edge is introduced.
The public Cloud IAM API structs and OpenAPI runtime bindings are unchanged; this ChangeSet proves behavior already represented by the STS token contract.
Fixtures are named by IAM concept and kept near existing principal/role helpers.
Assertions cover non-secret token_fingerprint and request-visible session metadata without exposing credentials.
External principals must include external_id; denial is policy-forbidden rather than silently issuing credentials.
No secrets, SDK credentials, or network calls are introduced.
The additional tests use bounded in-memory domain state only.
Federated STS behavior is proven through existing STS API helpers instead of adding a parallel SSO-specific path.
Rollback is limited to one test file, two plan status docs, and evidence rows/files.
IP-004 and P01 status distinguish federated OIDC STS API runtime green from provider-managed IdP/live-smoke gaps.
The review boundary rejects over-claiming full IP completion or adding provider CRUD into the STS proof slice.
Oya VCS claim/work accepted before modifications; verify/done/promote remains the closeout path.
FD-001 evidence, multispectrum evidence, and audit-chain row use the same ChangeSet id.
No new special-case token path: external OIDC principals travel through the same STS issuance code as service principals.
The external principal/external_id trust model is cloud-provider-neutral and compatible with self-hosted IdP deployment.

F3_adversarial.diagnostic_asserted: External principals without external_id receive CloudIamError::ExternalIdRequired and HTTP 403.
findings: The negative fixture would fail if external principals could mint STS credentials without the external-id guard.
The API helper mirrors existing STS request construction and remains easy for handler integration tests to reuse.
Rejected adding provider CRUD or a separate SSO token endpoint in this slice; those are separately claimable boundaries.
Planning-closure and targeted Rust quality gates passed after status/evidence updates.
The runtime proof is deterministic and does not require live IdP credentials; live-smoke remains explicitly pending.
The ChangeSet claims federated STS API runtime only; it does not claim full IP-004 completion.
The ChangeSet carries CC-1 classification, multispectrum facets, no dependency additions, and a bounded verification loop.
